limits: Native phone initial-snap behavior unverified; no candidate implementation yet.
Visible before pseudos cannot be overwritten; competing targets and non-block layouts need separate handling.
Legacy WebKit custom scrollbar source is visible and final snapped SVG matches; Chromium SVG draws bars absent from the overlay source even at zero offset.
Firefox does not support the legacy WebKit scrollbar pseudo styles; zero difference there is not positive scrollbar acceptance.

validatedSummary.nativeIOS: not validated for the snap mechanism

replayInstructions: Build the recorded revision; serve test/browser/server.mjs at localhost:4373. Open separate Chromium/Firefox/WebKit CLI sessions at /test/browser/umd.html. Ensure /tmp/html-to-image-blob-check/scroll-native exists. Run each archived async(page) probe with playwright-cli run-code --filename, then read its Result JSON. initial-target checks state-loss/feature controls, block-matrix imports the unchanged shared fixture, scrollbars uses standard scrollbar declarations and legacy-bars uses only WebKit pseudo rules. Original executed scripts and immutable hashes are retained rather than represented as production tests.
